name: Swarm of Insects

source.note: Numbers follow the 2014 Monster Manual swarm of insects (the one Curse of Strahd uses for Baba Lysaga's swarms); the 2024 block isn't entered yet. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Reach is 5 ft here (the 2014 bites need the target in the swarm's space), and the weaker bites start at Bloodied, as for the 2024 swarms.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.summary: Shares spaces with other creatures and fits through insect-sized gaps; can't heal or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Bites

damage.when: instead, while the swarm is Bloodied

actions.summary: Many small bites; the damage drops once the swarm is Bloodied.

summary: A crawling, biting cloud of insects that pours over a victim; resists weapon damage.
